description: This file defines the EntityEcaReader class, which models the <entity-eca-reader> element in an entity configuration XML, including parsing logic for its 'name' attribute and nested 'resource' elements.

classes.name: EntityEcaReader
classes.description: Models the <entity-eca-reader> XML element, encapsulating its name and associated resource list, and provides accessors for these properties.

methods.name: EntityEcaReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityEcaReader instance by parsing the provided XML element, extracting the 'name' attribute and resource child elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute of the entity-eca-reader element.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of Resource objects representing the nested resource elements.
